_policy: Pre-registered targets for the Q3 key rework (#2079), frozen BEFORE any DSP change lands. Modeled on the predict/drop frozen.json discipline: numbers move or the change reverts. Profile/constant selection reads the TUNE half only; the holdout half is scored once, at the end of the round. Split rule: int(sha256(track_id),16) % 2 == 0 -> tune (canonical: analyze_predict_drop.py is_tune). chosen_config stays null until the final report-card commit.

targets.no_estimate_rate: <= 0.05 (profile swap moves the correlation scale vs the 0.3 emit gate)
targets.guard_datasets: harmonix beat-F/downbeat-F/tempo-acc1 + structure pairwise/boundary, ballroom beat-F, giantsteps_tempo acc1 each within 0.02 of the #2077 report card, or the regression is stated and explicitly accepted with rationale

iteration_cmd: bench/run_bench.py bench/datasets/giantsteps_key --jobs 4 --out-root bench/out/q-iter $(python3 -c "import json; print(' '.join('--only '+t for t in json.load(open('bench/manifests/dev_subset.json'))['tracks']['giantsteps_key']))")
